implementation_boundary: Recognize documented TIME/POG/pupil/validity fields; do not invent vendor fields.
Treat LPD/RPD as pixel diameters and LPUPILD/RPUPILD as metre-valued 3-D pupil diameters; never silently relabel units.
Construct only a closed Gaussian identity-link formula; users cannot supply arbitrary formulas or families.
Use brms/mgcv smooth terms only through package-constructed approved formulas and bounded basis dimensions.
Allow an approved Gaussian AR(1) term by series/sample order only when sampling intervals satisfy the package irregularity guard.
Use explicit folds tied to a declared prediction target; do not default to observation-wise CV as universally appropriate.
Distinguish known-trial, new-trial, new-participant, and future-segment targets; partition data to match the target.
Use finite chronological future splits for the future-segment target; do not relabel generic LOO as future prediction validation.

source: Mathot 2018, Pupillometry: Psychology, Physiology, and Function
implementation_boundary: Treat pupil response as a measurement outcome affected by sensory and physiological factors; never automatically translate dilation into a psychological construct.

source: Kret and Sjak-Shie 2019, Preprocessing pupil size data: Guidelines and code
implementation_boundary: Audit blink/interpolation decisions and provenance; do not silently interpolate, smooth, or overwrite upstream preprocessing.

source: Hayes and Petrov 2016, Mapping and correcting the influence of gaze position on pupil size measurements
implementation_boundary: Audit gaze-position/PFE status and support user-supplied corrected-versus-uncorrected sensitivity alternatives; do not implement a universal correction.
Declare/audit luminance and contrast and permit nuisance/sensitivity adjustment; defer full dynamic visual decomposition to 0.5.
Do not duplicate a generic pupil preprocessing pipeline; gp3bayes consumes audited/preprocessed traces and records decisions.
Keep preprocessing decisions explicit and upstream-compatible rather than replacing established preprocessing packages.

source: Rahme et al. 2025, Evaluating the Validity of Gazepoint GP3 HD in Assessing Listening Effort: A Pupillometry Study
implementation_boundary: Provide first-class Gazepoint interoperability while retaining vendor-neutral statistical contracts and conservative interpretation.
